item.title: Calm Capybara Holding Space and Snacks Therapist
item.description: A calm capybara sits upright with a little bag of snacks, holding space for everyone and holding treats too. It makes a funny gift for therapists, counselors and mental health pros. Find it on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
